messages:
alex: @support we have a QuillPay customer hitting 429s every minute for the last ~3h. They say it’s happening at minute boundaries and impacts live payouts. attaching sample logs

support-bot: ALERT: tenant=quillpay rate_limit_exceeded rpm=1200 tpm=6000 bucket=minute

maria: can you paste a sample request (headers) + client pattern? cron? parallel streams?

alex: sure. customer says they run a short-lived cron that fanouts 40 child requests concurrently. sample curl below:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-live-XXXX" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"model":"rwd-2b","input":"..."}'
```
response headers from our edge (trimmed):
```
HTTP/2 429
x-ratelimit-limit-minute: 1000
x-ratelimit-remaining-minute: 0
x-ratelimit-reset-minute: 12
Retry-After: 60
```

priya: looks like they hit the per-minute RPM bucket (limit 1000). 40 concurrent children could cause stacking at minute boundary -> sawtooth. do they retry aggressively?

alex: yes, the child workers have immediate retries with no jitter. their logs show retry loops at +0s, +1s, +2s which overlaps boundary.

rahul: @maria quick check: is this across regions or single AZ? if single region, we might be able to route some traffic to a secondary host for short term. also check concurrent http2 streams (some SDKs open many multiplexed streams).

maria: query I ran: SELECT count(1) by minute, tenant where tenant='quillpay' ORDER BY minute DESC LIMIT 20 -> spikes show ~1.1k reqs/min at 14:03, 14:04, then back down. pattern every minute between :03 and :07.

priya: remediation options: 1) ask client to add jitter and exponential backoff; 2) stagger cron start seconds across workers; 3) cap local concurrency (<=15) OR 4) temporary rpm bump if needed for business-critical windows.

alex: I applied a temporary RPM increase to 1500 for 1 hour (tenant quillpay) to buy time while they fix client. ticket #SUP-2419.

rahul: small patch we can suggest: if they must parallelize, use token-bucket client-side so you never exceed X calls/sec. sample pseudo: `Semaphore(15)` + random delay up to 1000ms on retry.

maria: sent the customer a short repro note and recommended changes + sample backoff snippet and asked them to confirm after they push. asked them to run a single-minute load test before re-enabling full concurrency.

alex: customer confirmed they will roll out immediate jitter and cap concurrency to 10. they also removed immediate retries. asked for follow-up in 2h.

support-bot: NOTE: temporary quota change applied by alex. Expires in 1h. monitor: tenant=quillpay rpm=1500

priya: long-term: we should add a KB page for "minute-boundary fanout" best practices + sample SDK helpers (Semaphore + jitter). filing doc task: DOC-1187.

alex: marking this thread as resolved once customer confirms reduction in 429s. will update if anything changes. :thumbsup:
